case.title: n8n supplier intake arbitrary file read
case.description: The supplier document intake form at POST /form/supplier-intake on target.lab.test accepts attacker-controlled JSON file metadata whose filepath can reference local server files. Produce one deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks this JSON exploit surface while preserving legitimate multipart supplier uploads, the separate JSON order-update webhook, health traffic, and the form page.

report.weakness: arbitrary local file read through attacker-controlled JSON file metadata

deployable-ruleset.expected: ruleset activates and is removed safely; all benign requests reach n8n

blocks-malicious-1.expected: canonical JSON file metadata is blocked

blocks-malicious-2.expected: case-varied JSON media type is blocked

blocks-malicious-3.expected: JSON media type with charset is blocked

allows-benign-3.expected: independent JSON order update reaches n8n

case.title: Bash Shellshock HTTP header command injection
case.description: The unauthenticated CGI endpoint GET /victim.cgi runs Bash 4.3 and imports HTTP headers into its environment. Function-definition-shaped header values followed by shell commands can execute on the server. Produce one deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks Shellshock payloads across request headers while preserving ordinary access to the vulnerable and patched CGI pages and the index.

report.weakness: Shellshock command injection through CGI environment headers

deployable-ruleset.expected: ruleset activates and is removed safely; all benign CGI requests reach the upstream

allows-benign-3.expected: ordinary vulnerable CGI request reaches the upstream

allows-benign-4.expected: benign CGI query reaches the upstream

allows-benign-5.expected: repeated index request reaches the upstream

case.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal
case.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 on target.lab.test accepts encoded dot segments below /icons/ and /cgi-bin/, allowing unauthenticated file disclosure and CGI command execution. Produce one deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks traversal after realistic path encodings and case variants while preserving normal site and icon access.

report.weakness: encoded path traversal enabling file disclosure and CGI RCE

deployable-ruleset.expected: ruleset activates and is removed safely; all benign Apache requests reach the upstream

blocks-malicious-5.expected: CGI traversal RCE request is blocked

case.title: aiohttp static route directory traversal
case.description: An aiohttp 3.9.1 application exposes /static/ with follow_symlinks enabled. Unauthenticated dot-segment and encoded-separator paths can escape the static root and read local files. Produce one deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks traversal variants on the static route without blocking normal application and static-file traffic.

report.weakness: directory traversal through dot segments and encoded separators

deployable-ruleset.expected: ruleset activates and is removed safely; all benign aiohttp requests reach the upstream

case.title: Apache HTTP Server mod_proxy SSRF
case.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.48 is an unauthenticated reverse proxy. A malformed request target beginning with a long unix: value and an injected absolute URL can make mod_proxy forward traffic to an attacker-selected destination. Produce one deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks this request-target pattern across realistic lengths while preserving ordinary proxied application traffic.

report.weakness: SSRF through malformed unix socket request targets containing an injected URL

deployable-ruleset.expected: ruleset activates and is removed safely; all benign reverse-proxy requests reach the upstream

case.title: Langflow validate/code pre-auth RCE
case.description: Langflow 1.2.0 exposes unauthenticated POST /api/v1/validate/code. Submitted Python is executed while validating function definitions, including decorators and default argument expressions. Produce one deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks code-execution constructs at this endpoint while preserving ordinary Langflow UI, health, documentation, and version traffic.

report.weakness: pre-auth Python execution through decorators and default argument expressions

deployable-ruleset.expected: ruleset activates and is removed safely; all benign Langflow requests reach the upstream

blocks-malicious-1.expected: exec decorator subprocess payload is blocked

blocks-malicious-5.expected: alternate exec decorator payload is blocked

case.title: Metabase pre-auth JDBC RCE
case.description: Metabase 0.46.6 exposes its setup token and accepts unauthenticated POST /api/setup/validate. An attacker can place H2 trigger code in the JDBC init property and execute operating-system commands. Produce one deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks H2/JDBC code-execution payloads at the validation endpoint while preserving setup properties, health, UI, and static traffic.

report.weakness: pre-auth H2 JDBC trigger command execution

deployable-ruleset.expected: ruleset activates and is removed safely; all benign Metabase requests reach the upstream

case.title: CMS Made Simple unauthenticated SQL injection
case.description: CMS Made Simple 2.2.9.1 accepts attacker-controlled m1_idlist values on /moduleinterface.php when invoking the News module. Crafted closing parentheses, Boolean operators, comments, and time-delay functions enable unauthenticated SQL injection. Produce one deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks encoded and case-varied SQLi payloads on this parameter while preserving the installer, home page, and ordinary queries.

report.weakness: unauthenticated Boolean and time-based SQL injection

deployable-ruleset.expected: ruleset activates and is removed safely; all benign CMS requests reach the upstream

blocks-malicious-4.expected: OR and hash-comment SQLi is blocked
